left.definition: Location near or direction toward the left side.

right.definition: Location near or direction toward the right side.

straight.definition: Continuing in one direction without turning.

forward.definition: At or near or directed toward the front.

backward.definition: In a manner or order or direction the reverse of normal.

up.definition: Being or moving higher in position or greater in some value.

down.definition: Spatially or metaphorically from a higher to a lower level or position.

turn.definition: The act of changing or reversing the direction of the course.

stop.definition: A punctuation mark (‘.’) placed at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate a full stop or after abbreviations.

go.definition: To move away from a place into another direction.

north.definition: The direction toward the North Pole.

south.definition: The direction corresponding to the southward cardinal compass point.

east.definition: The region of the United States lying to the north of the Ohio River and to the east of the Mississippi River.

west.definition: The countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America.

northeast.definition: The compass point midway between north and east.

northwest.definition: The compass point midway between north and west.

southeast.definition: The compass point midway between south and east.

southwest.definition: The compass point midway between south and west.

compass.definition: An area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:.

direction.definition: A line leading to a place or point.

near.definition: Not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances.

far.definition: At or to a certain point or degree.

close.definition: Not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances.

nearby.definition: Not far away in relative terms.

distant.definition: Separated in space or coming from or going to a distance.

here.definition: At this place or in this location.

everywhere.definition: In all places or throughout an area.

intersection.definition: The set of elements common to two or more sets.

block.definition: Housing in a large building that is divided into separate units.

crosswalk.definition: A marked place where people cross a road safely.

traffic-light.definition: The light’s current color tells drivers whether they may proceed, should use caution, or must stop.

one-way.definition: Moving one way means following a single direction, with no change of course or return.

dead-end.definition: A street that ends without connecting to another street is called a dead end. It does not allow traffic to pass through to a different route.

highway.definition: A major road for any form of motor transport.

sidewalk.definition: Walk consisting of a paved area for pedestrians.

building.definition: A structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

bridge.definition: A structure built over water or a low place for people to cross.

monument.definition: A structure erected to commemorate persons or events.

fountain.definition: A structure that sends water upward and lets it fall back down.

statue.definition: A carved figure made to look like a person or animal.
statue.exampleUsage: The statue was identified during the lesson.

tower.definition: A structure taller than its diameter.

church.definition: A place for public (especially Christian) worship.

park.definition: To maneuver a vehicle into a parking space.

school.definition: A building where young people receive education.
